name: xcodebuildmcp

tools.name: session_show_defaults
tools.description: Show current active defaults. Required before your first build/run/test call in a session — do not assume defaults are configured.

tools.name: session_use_defaults_profile
tools.description: Switch the active session defaults profile.

profile.description: Activate a named session defaults profile (example: ios or watch).

global.description: Activate the global unnamed defaults profile.

tools.name: session_set_defaults
tools.description: Set session defaults for the active profile, or for a specified profile and make it active.

configuration.description: Build configuration for Xcode and SwiftPM tools (e.g. 'Debug' or 'Release').

derivedDataPath.description: Default DerivedData path for Xcode build/test/clean tools.

preferXcodebuild.description: Prefer xcodebuild over incremental builds for Xcode build/test/clean tools.

platform.description: Default device platform for device tools (e.g. iOS, watchOS).

bundleId.description: Default bundle ID for launch/stop/log tools when working on a single app.

env.description: Default environment variables to pass to launched apps.

profile.description: Set defaults for this named profile and make it active for the current session.

createIfNotExists.description: Create the named profile if it does not exist. Defaults to false.

tools.name: session_clear_defaults
tools.description: Clear session defaults for the active profile or a specified profile.

profile.description: Clear defaults for this named profile instead of the active profile.

all.description: Clear all defaults across global and named profiles. Cannot be combined with keys/profile.

tools.name: list_sims
tools.description: List iOS simulators.

tools.name: boot_sim
tools.description: Boot iOS simulator for manual/non-build flows. Not required before simulator build-and-run (build_run_sim).

tools.name: open_sim
tools.description: Open Simulator.app for visibility/manual workflows. Not required before simulator build-and-run (build_run_sim).

tools.name: build_sim
tools.description: Build for iOS sim (compile-only, no launch).

tools.name: build_run_sim
tools.description: Build, install, and launch on iOS Simulator; boots simulator and attempts to open Simulator.app as needed. Runtime logs are captured automatically and the log file path is included in the response. Preferred single-step run tool when defaults are set.

extraArgs.description: Additional xcodebuild/build-settings arguments (not app launch arguments)

launchArgs.description: Arguments passed to the launched app process on simulator runtime

tools.name: test_sim
tools.description: Test on iOS sim.

testRunnerEnv.description: Environment variables to pass to the test runner (TEST_RUNNER_ prefix added automatically)

progress.description: Show detailed test progress output (MCP defaults to true, CLI defaults to false)

tools.name: get_sim_app_path
tools.description: Get sim built app path.

tools.name: install_app_sim
tools.description: Install app on sim.

appPath.description: Path to the .app bundle to install

tools.name: launch_app_sim
tools.description: Launch app on simulator. Runtime logs are captured automatically and the log file path is included in the response.

launchArgs.description: Arguments passed to the launched app process on simulator runtime

env.description: Environment variables to pass to the launched app (SIMCTL_CHILD_ prefix added automatically)

tools.name: stop_app_sim
tools.description: Stop sim app.

tools.name: record_sim_video
tools.description: Record sim video.

tools.name: clean
tools.description: Clean build products.

tools.name: discover_projs
tools.description: Scans a directory (defaults to workspace root) to find Xcode project (.xcodeproj) and workspace (.xcworkspace) files. Use when project/workspace path is unknown.

tools.name: list_schemes
tools.description: List Xcode schemes.

tools.name: show_build_settings
tools.description: Show build settings.

tools.name: get_app_bundle_id
tools.description: Extract bundle id from .app.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture screenshot.

returnFormat.description: Return image path or base64 data (path|base64)

tools.name: snapshot_ui
tools.description: Capture a semantic rs/1 runtime UI snapshot with elementRef targets. Observe once, use tap for one target or batch for multiple same-screen targets, and refresh after navigation, scrolling, sheet changes, or obvious layout changes.

sinceScreenHash.description: Return an unchanged response when the current screen hash matches this value

tools.name: get_coverage_report
tools.description: Show per-target code coverage from an xcresult bundle.

target.description: Filter results to a specific target name

showFiles.description: When true, include per-file coverage breakdown under each target

tools.name: get_file_coverage
tools.description: Show function-level coverage and uncovered line ranges for a specific file.

file.description: Source file name or path to inspect

showLines.description: When true, include uncovered line ranges from the archive

instructions:
XcodeBuildMCP provides comprehensive tooling for Apple platform development (iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS).

Prefer XcodeBuildMCP tools over shell commands for Apple platform tasks when available.

Capabilities:
- Session defaults: Configure project, scheme, simulator, and device defaults to avoid repetitive parameters
- Project discovery: Find Xcode projects/workspaces, list schemes, inspect build settings
- Simulator workflows: Build, run, test, install, and launch apps on iOS simulators; manage simulator state (boot, erase, location, appearance)
- Device workflows: Build, test, install, and launch apps on physical devices with code signing
- macOS workflows: Build, run, and test macOS applications
- Log capture: Stream and capture logs from simulators and devices
- LLDB debugging: Attach debugger, set breakpoints, inspect stack traces and variables, execute LLDB commands
- UI automation: Capture screenshots, inspect runtime UI snapshots, perform taps/swipes/gestures, type text, press hardware buttons, and batch multiple same-screen elementRef taps
- SwiftPM: Build, run, test, and manage Swift Package Manager projects
- Project scaffolding: Generate new iOS/macOS project templates

Only simulator workflow tools are enabled by default. If capabilities like device, macOS, debugging, or UI automation are not available, the user must configure XcodeBuildMCP to enable them. See https://xcodebuildmcp.com/docs/configuration for workflow configuration.

Simulator run flow:
- Before your first build, run, or test call in a session, you MUST call session_show_defaults to verify the active project/workspace, scheme, and simulator. Do not assume defaults are configured. Only skip this if you have already called session_show_defaults earlier in the current session.
- If session_show_defaults confirms project/workspace + scheme + simulator are set, call build_run_sim immediately (often with empty arguments).
- Use discover_projs only when session_show_defaults shows project/workspace is missing or wrong.
- Never call discover_projs speculatively or in parallel with session_show_defaults.
- Do not call boot_sim or open_sim as prerequisites for build_run_sim; build_run_sim boots and opens Simulator as needed.
